title: 第1章 少年萧叶
slug: 武破九荒全本免费-武破九荒最新章节列表
content_zh:
萧家村村头已经站了三十多位少年少女，他们正在练习一套名为‘猛虎拳’的拳法，呼啸的拳风荡开空气，看起来颇具声势。
在队伍当中，一位面容清秀，身穿粗布麻衣的少年，看起来极为醒目。
这少年看起来不过十五岁上下，但拳法如水银落地，生生不息，火候比其他人高出不止一筹。
就连以严厉出名的小辈教头萧大山，都露出极为罕见的笑容。
“不愧是叶哥，看他施展猛虎拳，丝毫不弱于山叔啊。”
“那是自然，叶哥可是有炼体境八重的实力，村内小辈中，也只有萧腾能和叶哥相比了。”
“萧腾也是炼体境八重的实力，你们说他和叶哥哪个更强？”一位少年突然道。
此言一出，顿时引起了其他人的兴趣。
武道从炼体境开始，以淬炼体魄为主，分一至九重，村内的小辈，大多才停留在炼体六重左右而已。
“切，萧腾能有如今的实力，还不是因为他爹是猎兽队的队长，可以享受修炼资源。而叶哥却是独自苦修的，他哪里能和叶哥相比？”一位少女反驳道。
“话不能这么说，萧腾毕竟也有炼体八重的实力，未必就会比叶哥弱。”一位少年悠悠道。
“我和萧腾，谁更强？”听着众人的议论声，萧叶抹去头上的汗水，微微一笑。
这种话他已经听过无数遍了。
他和萧腾被称为村内最为出色的两个小辈，难免会被人放在一起比较。
如果是以前，萧腾的确有资格做他的对手，但是众人却不知道，昨天晚上，他已经突破到了炼体境九重了。
只是这个消息，萧叶还没来得急公布，只有萧大山知道。
“哼，都想受罚是吧！”
萧大山是一位精壮的汉子，他双目如电，扫过那些讨论得正火热的少年少女，顿时让他们打了个寒颤，乖乖继续练拳。
萧大山作为小辈教头，在村子中可是出了名的严厉，他们自然不敢顶撞。
此时，站在队伍中一位身材高大的少年，正满脸怨恨的望着萧叶。

他正是萧腾，是村里小辈中的佼佼者，与未曾突破前的萧叶，并列炼体八重。
“我实力可不比你差，凭什么别人一直认为我不如你？”萧腾盯着萧叶，心中充满了怨气。
若论萧腾在萧家村最怨恨谁，显然就是萧叶。
萧腾的爹，是萧家村猎兽队的队长，每次获得的好处也是最多，经常换取各种药材，大力培养他。
而萧叶的家庭条件，却是整个村子最差的，连吃肉都很少。
在这样的情况下，萧叶却能与他并列，很多村民都暗地里谈论，萧叶才是萧家村第一天才，这让萧腾怎能不怨恨？
“哼，等我爹买来炼体丹，让我突破到炼体九重，到时候我要当着全村人的面，将你击败，让所有人知道，我才是萧家村第一天才！”
队伍中的萧叶练习着猛虎拳，心头思绪翻滚。
“我的实力，虽然在萧家村小辈中可称第一又如何，不能进入重阳门，获得灵丹妙药，就不能治好爹的暗疾！”
萧叶想起自己窘迫的家境，暗暗握紧了拳头。
他爹萧阳遭受意外，全身经脉俱碎，从一位实力强大的武者，变成病痛缠身的病秧子，非灵丹妙药不可根治。
然而萧家村地处黑龙国的青阳镇，是贫瘠之地，哪里会有灵丹妙药？
一次偶然的机会，他从村内古籍上得知了，重阳门这样的武道圣地。
重阳门，是黑龙国最强大的宗门之一，其内弟子过万，走出过不少赫赫有名的强者，传闻门内有灵丹妙药，可以修复武者经脉。
而每三年，重阳门都会选拔一批新弟子入门，补充新鲜血液。
“重阳门是武道圣地，每次选拔弟子，整个黑龙国的少年都会前往。”
“黑龙国地大物博，名门望族的子弟不计其数，他们自小服用药材辅助炼体，突破到炼体九重，并不算困难！”
萧叶心中充满压力，他很清楚，名门望族的子弟，起点比他高出太多。以炼体九重的实力，要想通过重阳门的入门考核，希望渺茫……
当村内小辈盯着第一天才的头衔时，萧叶早就放眼整个黑龙国了。
“要稳入重阳门，除非我能突破到后天境！”萧叶低声道，“可要突破到后天境，实在太难了！”

当肉体淬炼到一定层次，体内便会衍生出真气，这便是后天境。

content_en:
There are already more than thirty boys and girls standing at the end of Xiaojiacun. They are practicing a set of boxing techniques called 'Tiger Fist'. The whistling wind of the boxing blows through the air and looks quite impressive.
Among the team, there was a young man with a delicate face, wearing coarse linen clothes, who looked very eye-catching.
This young man looks to be only about fifteen years old, but his boxing skills are like mercury falling to the ground, and his fire level is much higher than others.
Even the junior coach Xiao Dashan, who was famous for his strictness, showed an extremely rare smile.
"As expected of Brother Ye, look at him using the Tiger Fist. He is no weaker than Uncle Shan."
"That's natural. Brother Ye has the strength of the eighth level of the Body Refining Realm. Among the juniors in the village, only Xiao Teng can compare with Brother Ye."
"Xiao Teng is also at the eighth level of the Body Refining Realm. Who do you think is stronger, him or Brother Ye?" a young man said suddenly.
As soon as this statement came out, it immediately aroused the interest of others.
Martial arts starts from the body refining realm, focusing on tempering the body, which is divided into levels one to nine. Most of the juniors in the village only stay at around the sixth level of body refining.
"Tch, Xiao Teng is as strong as he is now, not because his father is the captain of the hunting team and can enjoy training resources. But Brother Ye trains alone, how can he compare with Brother Ye?" A girl retorted.
"You can't say that. After all, Xiao Teng also has the strength of the eighth level of body training, so he may not be weaker than Brother Ye." A young man said leisurely.
"Who is stronger, Xiao Teng or me?" Listening to everyone's discussion, Xiao Ye wiped the sweat from his head and smiled slightly.
He has heard this statement countless times.
He and Xiao Teng are known as the two most outstanding juniors in the village, and it is inevitable that they will be compared together.
If it were before, Xiao Teng would indeed be qualified to be his opponent, but everyone didn't know that last night, he had already broken through to the ninth level of the Body Refining Realm.
It's just that Xiao Ye didn't rush to announce this news yet, and only Xiao Dashan knew about it.
"Humph, you all want to be punished, right?"
Xiao Dashan was a strong man. His eyes were like lightning, and he glanced at the boys and girls who were having a heated discussion. He immediately made them shiver and continue to practice boxing obediently.
As a junior coach, Xiao Dashan was famously strict in the village, so naturally they did not dare to contradict him.
At this time, a tall young man standing in the team was looking at Xiao Ye with resentment on his face.
He is Xiao Teng, the leader among the younger generation in the village. He is ranked at the eighth level of body refining with Xiao Ye, who had never made a breakthrough before.
"My strength is not inferior to yours, why do others always think that I am inferior to you?" Xiao Teng stared at Xiao Ye, filled with resentment in his heart.
If we talk about who Xiao Teng resents the most in Xiaojia Village, it is obviously Xiao Ye.
Xiao Teng's father is the captain of Xiaojiacun's hunting team. He also gets the most benefits every time. He often exchanges for various medicinal materials and vigorously trains him.
However, Xiao Ye's family conditions are the worst in the whole village, and he even eats very little meat.
Under such circumstances, Xiao Ye was able to stand alongside him. Many villagers secretly talked about Xiao Ye being the number one genius in Xiaojia Village. How could Xiao Teng not be resentful of this?
"Hmph, when my father buys the body refining pill and lets me break through to the ninth level of body refining, then I will defeat you in front of the whole village and let everyone know that I am the number one genius in Xiaojia Village!"
Xiao Ye, who was in the team, was practicing the Tiger Fist, his mind racing with thoughts.
"It doesn't matter that my strength ranks first among the juniors in Xiaojiacun. If I can't enter the Chongyang Gate and get the panacea, I won't be able to cure my father's hidden illness!"
Xiao Ye thought of his embarrassing family situation and secretly clenched his fists.
His father, Xiao Yang, suffered an accident, and his whole body's meridians were shattered. From a powerful warrior, he turned into a sick man riddled with ailments that could not be cured without a panacea.
However, Xiaojiacun is located in Qingyang Town of the Black Dragon Kingdom. It is a barren land. Where can there be a panacea?
By chance, he learned about a martial arts holy place like Chongyang Gate from ancient books in the village.
HeavyYangmen is one of the most powerful sects in the Black Dragon Kingdom. It has over ten thousand disciples and has produced many famous and strong men. It is said that there is a panacea in the sect that can repair the meridians of warriors.
And every three years, the Chongyang Sect will select a group of new disciples to start the school to add fresh blood.
"Chongyang Gate is a holy land of martial arts. Every time a disciple is selected, young people from the entire Black Dragon Kingdom will go there."
"The Black Dragon Kingdom is vast and rich in resources, and there are countless children from famous families. They have been taking medicinal materials to assist in body refining since they were young, and it is not difficult for them to break through to the ninth level of body refining!"
Xiao Ye was full of pressure. He knew very well that the starting point of the children of famous families was much higher than his. With the strength of the ninth level of body refining, there is little hope of passing the entrance examination of the Chongyang Sect...
While the juniors in the village were eyeing the title of number one genius, Xiao Ye had already set his sights on the entire Black Dragon Kingdom.
"To enter the Chongyang Sect, unless I can break through to the acquired realm!" Xiao Ye whispered, "But it is too difficult to break through to the acquired realm!"
When the physical body is tempered to a certain level, true energy will be derived from the body. This is the acquired state.
